project_name.justification: The article is titled 'Mink Ventures Completes Payments to Earn 80% Interest in Montcalm'.

company_name.justification: The acquiring company is identified as 'Mink Ventures Corporation (TSXV: MINK) ("Mink" or the "Company")'.

ceo_buyer.justification: The contact for Mink Ventures Corporation is listed as 'Natasha Dixon, President & CEO, T: 250-882-5620 E: [ndixon@minkventures.com]'.

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The text states Mink Ventures will 'earn its 80% interest in the Montcalm Ni Cu Co Project'.

primary_commodity.justification: The project is referred to as the 'Montcalm Ni Cu Co Project' and the company is 'exploring for critical minerals (nickel, copper, cobalt)'.

verified_article_link.justification: The article is about the Montcalm project, as stated in the title: 'Mink Ventures Completes Payments to Earn 80% Interest in Montcalm'.

currency.justification: The acquiring company, Mink Ventures Corporation, is listed on the TSX Venture Exchange (TSXV), and payments are denoted with a '$' symbol, implying Canadian Dollars. 'Mink Ventures Corporation (TSXV: MINK)... made the second and final $25,000 cash payment'.

cash_payments_raw.justification: The text states that Mink 'made the second and final $25,000 cash payment required under the option agreement'.

share_payments_raw.justification: No specific dollar value is assigned to the share issuance in the text.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: The text does not provide a single combined value for the cash and share payments.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: The text states that Mink 'issued the second and final tranche of 800,000 shares to Voltage Metals Corp.'

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: Share warrants are not mentioned as part of the transaction terms.

option_payments_raw.justification: Options are not mentioned as a form of payment in the transaction terms.

issued_share_price.justification: The transaction terms mention the number of shares issued (800,000), but not the price. Using the last traded price as a fallback, as seen in the detailed quote: 'Last: 0.08'.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: No exploration commitment in terms of drilling meters is mentioned.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: The text states, 'In addition, Mink has expended the required $600,000 in exploration expenditures on the project'.

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: No Net Smelter Royalty (NSR) is mentioned as being acquired or retained in the transaction.

coverage_area_raw.justification: The text states, 'The Montcalm Project, covers 40 km2 adjacent to Glencore's former Montcalm Mine'.

coverage_area_unit.justification: The unit for the coverage area is specified in the text: 'The Montcalm Project, covers 40 km2'.

resource_size.value: 3.93 million tonnes of ore grading 1.25% Ni, 0.67% Cu and 0.051% Co
resource_size.justification: The text refers to a historical resource on the adjacent property: 'Glencore's former Montcalm Mine which had historical production of 3.93 million tonnes of ore grading 1.25% Ni, 0.67% Cu and 0.051% Co (Ontario Geological Survey, Atkinson, 2010)'.

buyer_ticker_and_exchange.justification: The buyer is identified in the text as 'Mink Ventures Corporation (TSXV: MINK)'.
